description: This file declares a utility class 'nmUtils' within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It provides static methods related to network management, such as retrieving device properties, interface names, hostname management, and network security mode interpretation. The class references external network management headers and defines several constant marker file paths.

classes.name: nmUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for network-related operations and device property management.

methods.name: getDeviceProperties
methods.description: Retrieves properties of network devices, details unspecified.

methods.name: wlanIface
methods.description: Returns the name of the WLAN interface.

methods.name: ethIface
methods.description: Returns the name of the Ethernet interface.

methods.name: convertPercentageToSignalStrength
methods.description: Converts signal percentage to a signal strength value.

methods.name: caseInsensitiveCompare
methods.description: Performs case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: wifiSecurityModeFromAp
methods.description: Determines Wi-Fi security mode from access point info.

methods.name: wifiFrequencyFromAp
methods.description: Calculates frequency from access point data.

methods.name: getSecurityModeString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of security mode based on flags.

methods.name: setNetworkManagerlogLevelToTrace
methods.description: Sets NetworkManager log level to trace for debugging.

methods.name: setMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates or removes a marker file for interface disable/enable.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a network interface is enabled.

calls: setMarkerFile(const char* filename, bool unmark = false)
